title: AI Ethics and Bias
description: Examine ethical considerations in AI development, including algorithmic bias, fairness, and accountability.
overview: Explore the ethical dimensions of artificial intelligence, focusing on bias, fairness, and responsible AI development. This lesson addresses critical questions about how AI systems should be designed and deployed.
learningObjectives: Identify sources of bias in AI systems
Understand fairness metrics and evaluation methods
Learn about ethical frameworks for AI development
Develop strategies for building responsible AI systems
